mapper.select: select id,member_id as memberId,product_type as productType,publish_mode as publishMode,del_flag as delFlag, name,description,category_ids as categoryIds,img_url as imgUrl,coalesce(config_version,0) as configVersion from cms_topic where id=#{id} for update
select id,name,description,blocks from cms_topic_chapter where topic_id=#{topicId} order by sort_id is null, sort_id, id

select id,chapter_id as chapterId,name,description,address,longitude,latitude,img_url as imgUrl, node_time as nodeTime,template_id as templateId from cms_topic_node where topic_id=#{topicId} order by chapter_id, sort_id is null, sort_id, id

select id,title,description,category_id as categoryId,activity_categoryids as activityCategoryIds,img_url as imgUrl, players,usage_location as usageLocation,required_materials as requiredMaterials,duration,difficulty, rule_instructions as ruleInstructions,validation_method as validationMethod,sensor_type as sensorType, cast(sensor_config as char) as sensorConfig,question_name as questionName,question_a as questionA,question_b as questionB, question_c as questionC,question_d as questionD,question_img as questionImg,question_audio as questionAudio, question_option_media_json as questionOptionMediaJson,feedback_text as feedbackText,story_text as storyText, story_img as storyImg,story_json as storyJson,hint1,hint2,photo_require_desc as photoRequireDesc,photo_review as photoReview, audio_url as audioUrl,audio_duration as audioDuration,interaction_type as interactionType,xp_value as xpValue, medal_name as medalName,medal_img as medalImg,cast(advanced_config_json as char) as advancedConfigJson, (coalesce(trim(question_answer),'')<>'' or coalesce(trim(correct_answer),'')<>'') as answerPresent from cms_member_template where id in #{id}
select id from audit_task where biz_type='TOPIC' and biz_id=#{topicId} and status in (0,3) and not (source_type <=> 'report') order by id desc limit 1
select max(id) from audit_record where task_id=#{taskId} and action='APPROVE'
mapper.sql: id,topic_id as topicId,member_id as memberId,request_id as requestId,observed_task_id as observedTaskId, observed_task_version as observedTaskVersion,source_config_version as sourceConfigVersion,snapshot_hash as snapshotHash, audit_task_id as auditTaskId,submitted_task_version as submittedTaskVersion,submitted_task_status as submittedTaskStatus, bundle_sha256 as bundleSha256
mapper.select: select from approved_topic_review_submission where member_id=#{memberId} and request_id=#{requestId}
select from approved_topic_review_submission where audit_task_id=#{taskId} order by id desc limit 1
select coalesce(max(revision_no),0) from approved_topic_release where topic_id=#{topicId}

select id,topic_id as topicId,member_id as memberId,request_id as requestId,revision_no as revisionNo, source_config_version as sourceConfigVersion,audit_task_id as auditTaskId,audit_record_id as auditRecordId, audit_task_version as auditTaskVersion,schema_version as schemaVersion,manifest_hash as manifestHash, audit_snapshot_hash as auditSnapshotHash from approved_topic_release where topic_id=#{topicId} and request_id=#{requestId}
